text: Let M be a compact smooth manifold of dimension n, and let E be a smooth finite-rank vector bundle over M with a fiber metric. If s is real, 1<p<infinity, and sp>n, then W^(s,p)(M,E) embeds continuously into L-infinity(M,E), and every section in that Sobolev space has a continuous representative.
